in_marathi.name: Sharvendraa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvendraa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvendraa is a name of Lord Shiva, the supreme god of Hinduism. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' (auspicious) and 'Andra' (lord or ruler). This name symbolizes strength, courage, and victory over all obstacles.
